uncertainties.zh: 右侧通向浴室的门洞是否已经过尚未确认。
uncertainties.en: It is not yet confirmed whether the doorway on the right leading to the bathroom has been passed.

uncertainties.zh: B 处是否仍完全处于走廊中、或已接近卧室入口，尚未确认。
uncertainties.en: It is not yet confirmed whether B is still entirely within the hallway or already near the bedroom entrance.
